Is travel to Morocco safe for women?   Generally, I would say yes, it is definitely a safe place for women to travel, and I think the bad reputation mainly comes from Marrakesh. There are so many amazing cities to visit in Morocco. Where should you visit in Morocco? Fes is one city that I really loved. Another city to visit in Morocco? Definitely go to Essaouira, but also to Casablanca, and Tangier. Do not forget about the desert! The best desert I’ve been to in potentially my life is in Merzouga! Make sure you do not go to the Agafay desert… you need to make sure you go to the further desert because it is absolutely gorgeous   I do think that I explain in my video, however, it goes a little bit deeper than just a city having small streets and being uncomfortable, because of the way that men act I think it is directly tied tourism , so while I would not say avoid Marrakesh, I would just say, be vigilant and ignore, and that speak to you if you’re alone. The bottom line is travel to Morocco is safe. Tourism and Morocco is safe. Moroccans are very kind in hospital people, so should you travel to Morocco? Yes. Morocco is safe for solo female travelers.
